jobs.title: Content & Social Manager
jobs.description: TITLE:  Content & Social Manager REPORTING TO:  Chief Marketing Officer LOCATION: Marina del Rey, CA - OR - Williamsburg, BK (Onsite Monday - Friday) Who The Flip Is Flip? Ever call your local taxi company, healthcare provider, or favorite eCommerce brand, and have a crazy good Voice AI answer? That’s Flip. Hundreds of brands from Brooklinen, Princess Polly, and Hexclad Cookware, to Tory Burch, Belk and the NFL trust Flip to have millions of phone calls with their customers every year. We’ve built our company on the idea that the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as our customer list, and a constant belief that the team is the best thing we’ve built. Both are true today and increasingly so every day. Many on our team would tell you this is their favorite place they’ve ever worked, and the hardest they’ve ever worked. It’s ideal for people who want to go all-in, do the work, ride the roller coaster, and have a great Flippin time doing it. We’re a small and mighty team of 50 today with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. What You’ll Own You'll drive how Flip builds interest, connections, and engagement on LinkedIn, key industry outlets (trade publications, sites, partner’s social channels, podcasts, etc.) and secondarily on other social channels like Instagram and Reddit. You’ll own the planning, budget and execution for all of Flip’s paid marketing - bringing the rigor to make sure every dollar is planned, tracked and optimized. You'll create, manage and execute Flip's LinkedIn presence and paid marketing strategy, the primary ways we reach and engage our BtoB audience and attract great talent, working closely with our Communications Marketing Manager on messaging strategy.  You will interview clients and turn real data into compelling stories and written case studies.  You'll turn case study interviews, company news, and product moments into content that gets people to engage with Flip and drives SEO/AEO. You'll also be a key content contributor to our website redesign, writing page copy and content across the site. You’ll support events and client gifting.  You will work closely with Flip’s awesome Marketing team members: Communications, Growth Marketing, Experiential and Video Marketing. Core Day-to-Day Manage LinkedIn day to day as our primary channel for reaching, engaging and growing our B to B audience and for attracting talent (leveraging Instagram and other social channels secondarily). You will be responsible for, in partnership with our Communications Manager on voice and messaging, developing and executing the plan, including: paid budget pacing, calendar, content creation, posting, engagement, creative testing, and reporting.  Own planning, tracking, and reporting for Flip's overall paid marketing budget, ensuring every dollar across channels is allocated intentionally and optimized based on performance. Manage paid, earned and organic reach to partner/industry publications, working closely with our PR firm as well as our Growth Marketing Manager to build awareness, increase Flip’s SEO and AEO results and to generate leads. Coordinate and conduct client interviews that demonstrate the real impact Flip makes on a client's business.  Write case studies and share across LinkedIn and partner channels. Repurpose video case studies produced by our Video Marketing Manager into written formats, social posts, and presentation slides Publish consistently across LinkedIn and our website, adapting content for each platform Write website content for our upcoming redesign, including page copy, product messaging, and case study integration, in close coordination with our Communications Manager and design and build partners Work with marketing, sales, and customer support to capture authentic stories and surface content opportunities Create content about Flip events, initiatives, and insights for our website, CRM, presentations, and social channels Test new formats, trends, and ideas to keep our content fresh Help with simple visual design when needed Support events and other marketing projects, including swag and client gifting The First 90 Days Build Flip's paid marketing plan and budget from the ground up across LinkedIn and industry outlets, and build the optimization engine -  testing, targeting, and creative iteration - working closely with Growth Marketing on reporting Identify and organize industry outlet opportunities into a plan and budget, working with our PR firm on coverage and placement Establish a working rhythm with the Communications Manager on voice, messaging, and content review Build relationships with Client Success Managers for client case studies Interview clients, create and publish written case studies as posts, articles and slides Contribute copy and content for the website redesign, in coordination with the Communications Manager and build partners Work with and support Experiential Marketing Manager to plan and execute events Work with Growth Marketing Manager for AEO, SEO, Hubspot and Website Support swag and client gifting initiatives What We're Looking For - Must-haves 3+ years of experience in BtoB social media and content marketing, managing paid budgets typical of a startup (not enterprise-scale spend) Proven hands-on experience running and optimizing paid LinkedIn campaigns — budget management, targeting, creative testing, and reporting - to reach and engage a BtoB audience and support talent attraction Hands-on experience managing AEO and SEO, including website content optimization and Hubspot Experience organizing and managing events, including trade shows and client events Comfortable creating simple visuals in Adobe Creative Suite or Canva to get posts done without heavy design support Strong writing and storytelling skills, able to shape technical or business impact into a compelling narrative, from short social copy to long-form website content and blog posts Hyper-organized and producer-like, able to build project plans, budgets, and processes/workflows  Works quickly, can-do attitude and puts ego aside Eager to use AI tools to complement creativity A genuine interest in people, creativity, and storytelling Understands what it's like to work at a startup, with the drive to build and refine processes that don't yet exist More About Us We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data We are hiring two Customer Content Marketers in this role; one for our eCom/retail vertical and one for our Healthcare vertical.  Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year In office 5 days/week   #FlippinLegend   Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for equity, in accordance with company policy, and subject to board approval. Compensation Range: $95,000 — $125,000 USD Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

jobs.description: TITLE: Customer Success Manager REPORTING TO : Director/Head of Customer Success LOCATION : Marina del Rey, CA (Onsite M-F) Who The Flip Is Flip? Ever call your favorite eCommerce brand or healthcare provider, and have a crazy good Voice AI answer? That’s Flip. Hundreds of brands from Under Armour and Tory Burch in retail to Experity and Fast Pace Health in healthcare trust Flip to have millions of phone calls with their customers every month. We’ve built our company on the idea that the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as our customer list, and a constant belief that the team is the best thing we’ve built. Both are true today and increasingly so every day. Many on our team would tell you this is their favorite place they’ve ever worked, and the hardest they’ve ever worked. It’s ideal for people who want to go all-in, do the work, ride the roller coaster, and have a great Flippin time doing it. We’re a small and mighty team of 50 today with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. What You’ll Do We are looking for a few customer success managers to join us. As a CSM you represent the brand at the most critical moment in the customer journey, leading the product implementation, and then own the relationship thereafter.  Our philosophy on growth – Be the most impactful product in our customers’ tech stack, their favorite vendor to work with, and give them a microphone to share their story in the community.  We believe every customer should feel like our first and only.  We believe in building in person relationships.  We believe how we do things today is written in pencil and everyone is responsible for improving it.  We believe in winning, especially in the hardest of moments.  We believe in deeply understanding our customers’ business, being a strategic thought partner, helping them connect with others in the community, and solving problems for them far beyond our scope.  We believe in going long – these aren’t transactional relationships, they’re deep partnerships that compound in value over time.  Who you are, As A Customer Success Manager  Lead product implementation (often before the sale is closed), including setting up integrations, product configurations, and training the customer how to use it Help sales win by getting new customers to success on their most important metrics FAST  Build deep lasting relationships, meet regularly with customers and communicate constantly over slack, text, in person, etc (and yes email too)  Help shape the product by deeply understand the customer and their business, as well as our product, to spot gaps and opportunities  Collaborate with marketing to bring new customers into our community and help them share their story Either already are or become obsessed with eCommerce customer experience/support Go above and beyond consistently  Our customers are our most valuable asset, and you are responsible for them.  Who You Are, As A Person Looking to go all-in, learn a lot, and do the best work of your career (so far!) Sick of being put in a box with a ceiling, you want to progress fast and see what you’re truly capable of  Are trusted with the most important things in the most important moments  Communicate well, and embrace ownership, speed, & occasional (frequent 😉) uncertainty Eager and willing to support your teammates - just like they will with you! Bonuses Know what it looks like to work at a startup, and have an entrepreneurial drive Experience at an early-stage Healthtech or Retail tech company (Series A–C) Familiarity with EHR/PM integrations (Epic, Athena, Experity, eClinicalWorks, etc.) Knowledge of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, HIPAA) Understanding of payer/provider dynamics and patient experience workflows More About Us We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data We are hiring multiple CSMs that will go into either our eCom/Retail OR Healthcare vertical Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year In office 5 days/week #FlippinLegend #LI-MDAD   Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for bonus and/or commission as well as equity, in accordance with company policy, and subject to board approval.  Compensation Range: $80,000 — $110,000 USD Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

Ever call your favorite eCommerce brand or healthcare provider, and have a crazy good Voice AI answer? That’s Flip. Hundreds of brands from Under Armour and Tory Burch in retail to Experity and Fast Pace Health in healthcare trust Flip to have millions of phone calls with their customers every month. We’re a small and mighty team of 50 today with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. What You’ll Do Make sure our reference list is as long as our customer list… Make Flip the most impactful tool in the tech stack for our customers, i.e. deliver business impact through our product, identify the problems they’re looking to solve, configure our product to optimize performance, and collaborate with our product team to constantly raise the roof. Be our customers’ favorite vendor to work with - build authentic, trust-based relationships where every interaction leaves clients feeling heard, supported, and excited about what’s possible. Expand our network of champions across all relevant stakeholders. Get on airplanes to meet them in person. Support prospects in evaluating our product, then lead implementation all the way through the lifetime of the relationship. Go above and beyond for their requests - make the extra test call, solve edge cases, and deliver outcomes customers didn’t even realize were possible. Become a product and domain expert quickly (within week 1) - master Flip’s platform (either ecom/retail or healthcare) workflows so you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise with authority. Unpack their problems and dig into the “why” - get past surface level issues to uncover root causes. Liaise with our product team to craft solutions - translate client needs into clear feedback that shapes our roadmap and strategy. Storytell with data - use metrics to show how Flip meets their goals, gives great patient experiences and delivers clear ROI. Partner with sales - work side-by-side to accelerate launch and automation through customer success, making Flip the reason they choose us and the reason they grow with us. Coach and scale the CS team - hire, mentor, and empower exceptional CSMs while raising the bar for execution and culture. Initially this role will be an IC for first ~6 months. Collaborate with marketing to bring new customers into our community by helping current customers share their story. Who you are, as a person High aptitude and high work ethic - you can do in an hour what takes most people 8, and choose to work 10 - because you love it. When there’s a Friday night fire after a long week, people want you in the room to help solve the problem - you bring a positive attitude when it’s hardest. You exercise creative persistence - finding a way to win even when there’s a great excuse for why you’d lose. You are craving a flippin rocketship to join and build. What you bring Startup experience and have seen a company scale their customer success from +10 clients to hundreds. Understand what it takes to build teams and implement scalable systems for long term success. +5 years of experience leading a CS function for a B2B software company. Strong communication skills both in-person and virtually between internal teams, client partners, stakeholders by embracing ownership. Ability to understand the why and persuasively communicate messaging for internal and external buy-in. Eager and willing to support your teammates - just like they will with you! Player-coach when it comes to developing a team of highly motivated individual contributors. Either already are or become obsessed with customer experience/support. Go above and beyond consistently. Nice to have Experience building customer success processes in both startup and enterprise contexts. Passion for storytelling and community building - helping customers share wins publicly. (Healthcare Vertical Specific) Previous experience with Healthtech company during its early stages, a-b-c Familiarity with EHR/PM integrations (Epic, Athena, Experity, eClinicalWorks, etc.) and healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, HIPAA). Strong understanding of payer/provider dynamics, patient experience workflows, and healthcare compliance considerations. More About Us We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data This Enterprise CSM role can go into either our ecom/retail vertical or healthcare, which will be determined before offer stage Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year In office 5 days/week   #FlippinLegend   Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Title: Events Marketing Manager Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer Location:  Brooklyn, NY or Marina del Rey, CA — onsite Monday–Friday Who is Flip? There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one-of-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country. The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling-and-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B+ TAMs each, and we're still early. We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true. The Role Events are one of the biggest ways we grow across the three industries we serve — retail, healthcare, and transportation. From major trade shows and conferences to client experiences (Flippin' Legends), brand activations, and internal company events, you'll own Flip's event presence end to end. You know the B2B trade show world inside and out, love planning the work and working the plan, and hold everyone around you to the same standard. Our creative and content teams bring the ideas — your job is to execute them exceptionally. Not just done, but done right, on time, and on budget. What You'll Own Trade shows & conferences.  Own Flip's presence end to end. Identify the right events across retail, healthcare, and transportation, negotiate sponsorships and booth packages, manage all logistics, and ensure Flip shows up in a way that turns heads and drives pipeline. Retail industry trade show experience is a strong plus. Pre-event planning.  Build detailed event plans and timelines well in advance. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and leadership to align on goals, messaging, and on-site experience. Manage all vendor relationships, contracts, and deadlines. Budget management & ROI.  Own event budgets from estimate through reconciliation, delivering maximum impact within a reasonable spend. Track and report ROI for every event — leads generated, pipeline influenced, brand impressions, follow-up conversion — and use that data to prioritize the events that deliver. On-site execution & team leadership.  Lead the team on the ground at every event. Manage setup, staffing, scheduling, and real-time problem solving. Ensure every detail is executed to plan and the Flip team is set up to have meaningful conversations and capture every lead. Post-event follow-through.  Debrief the team, report results, coordinate with sales on lead follow-up, and document learnings. Every event should make the next one better. Brand activations, swag & content.  Partner with creative and content to bring activations to life; source and track event merchandise and collateral; coordinate photo, video, and client interview capture for social and post-event promotion. Internal events.  Plan and coordinate events for the Flip team — company meetings, offsites, industry parties, and client dinners. What We're Looking For 3+ years managing B2B trade shows and industry conferences , with end-to-end ownership of logistics, sponsorships, and on-site execution. Retail industry familiarity is a strong plus  — you know its major trade shows and how buyers show up at them. Exceptional organizational and project management skills  — multiple events and deadlines at once, without dropping a detail. Proven budget ownership and ROI fluency.  You've built and managed event budgets, negotiated with vendors and organizers, and used performance data to inform future strategy. Strong leadership on the ground  — comfortable directing teams and vendors in a fast-paced environment, and holding partners accountable without losing the relationship. A natural collaborator  who translates creative and content teams' ideas into flawless execution. Relentless attention to detail.  You love a checklist, own every open item, and don't stop until everything is closed out. Adaptable and calm under pressure.  If you're a chaos-wrangler who brings order to complexity, we want to meet you. More About Us We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data We are hiring two Customer Content Marketers in this role; one for our eCom/retail vertical and one for our Healthcare vertical.  Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year In office 5 days/week   #FlippinLegend   Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: TITLE: Staff Software Engineer  REPORTING TO : CTO LOCATION : Marina del Rey, CA – OR – Williamsburg, NY (onsite M - F) Who Is Flip? Flip builds AI voice agents that handle millions of real customer conversations for some of the biggest brands, healthcare providers, and transportation companies in the world. When you call a company and the AI actually solves your problem — tracks the order, processes the return, refills the prescription — that’s us. We’re a low-ego team. We don’t need the limelight or the stardom — we care about solving really hard problems, fast. And here’s the part worth stopping on: outside the frontier labs, almost nobody is running AI in production at this scale. We are — millions and millions of live phone calls, handled by an engineering team a fraction of the size you’d expect. Very few teams our size serve this volume, and the reason is simple: we hold a very high bar for development. How we think From day one, we’ve operated on first principles, and the first principle is the customer. If you have strong conviction that something delivers real business value for your customer, it shouldn’t die in red tape or committee. You ship it — fast and often — because the customer is what actually matters. That’s why there’s a direct line from your keyboard to production here. We didn’t remove the committee to move fast for its own sake; we removed it because conviction plus customer obsession doesn’t need a permission slip. Agentic development has changed the way we work — we’re not shy about that. What it hasn’t changed is the necessity of experience, especially at the production level. You can ship faster than ever now; that doesn’t negate experience. Speed without judgment is how you break things millions of people depend on. That’s why this posting asks for senior and staff engineers: we’re hiring builders whose experience makes the new speed safe. Our view is simple: let builders build. We care a lot less about stack experience or corporate pedigree than most companies — and a lot more about whether you’ve looked past the noise and want to build product you’re genuinely proud of. Tools change monthly now. The instinct to build doesn’t. We keep the team lean on purpose — a high bar, real support, real resources — because that’s where builders truly express themselves. The most common thing we hear from engineers after joining Flip is some version of “I could never have done this at my last company” . Deep industry expertise matched with ruthless execution creates wonderful work. That’s the whole formula. What you’ll build We’re serving an orchestrated system of agents answering millions of contacts daily and now also expanding into other modalities like chat. Pulling that off requires elite engineering paired with incredible DevOps — voice is unforgiving: it’s real-time, there are no retries or page refreshes, and the customer is literally on the line. The work breaks into three lanes: Vertical engineering — building the agents themselves: complex multi-step customer workflows and deep integrations into the contact center and the industries we serve — order systems, healthcare workflows, logistics. This is where “mostly works” isn’t shippable. Platform engineering — the orchestration layer every agent runs on: routing, state, tool use, and the primitives that let vertical teams ship fast without reinventing the engine. Inference & DevOps — we host our own models; low-latency serving at production scale is a core competency here, not a vendor line item. Plus the telephony, observability, and deployment infrastructure that keeps millions of live calls healthy. And the range here is real. Our engineers do everything from sitting face-to-face with customers to going deep on complex backend systems — you really get to pick where you fit. We don’t slot you into one of these on day one. There’s probably a place for you — we’ll find it together, and it’ll probably change as we grow. What we look for We intentionally wrote this as one role for senior and staff engineers, because we believe builders love to build — and how they build varies. Some want the flexibility of working alone and joining forces when it counts; some do their best work in a small pod. We don’t prescribe it. What we do hold as a core principle: we are always raising the bar on each other. As we grow, our best builders often end up with two or three engineers building behind them — if that’s a direction you want, it’s here. And if you’d rather stay a pure builder, that raises the bar too. Real production experience. You’ve built and owned systems where failure had consequences. We don’t count years — we look at what you’ve shipped and what you learned shipping it. Judgment that survives contact with production. Agentic development is how we work — but what we’re actually hiring is your experience: knowing what to ship, what to slow down on, and what never to ship at all. Low ego, high execution. You own outcomes, not tickets. You’d rather ship the thing than present the plan for the thing. Customer obsession. You want to be close to the problem — sometimes literally in the room — and you measure yourself by what the customer got. More About Us We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada. We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive and Simon Data. Our tech stack includes Python, MongoDB, AWS, Twilio, Datadog, Snowflake, and Omni. Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year. In the office 5 days/week, we collaborate in real time on the desk. Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for equity, in accordance with company policy, and subject to board approval. Compensation Range: $200,000 — $400,000 USD Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

That’s why this posting asks for senior and staff engineers: we’re hiring builders whose experience makes the new speed safe. Our view is simple: let builders build. We care a lot less about stack experience or corporate pedigree than most companies — and a lot more about whether you’ve looked past the noise and want to build product you’re genuinely proud of. Tools change monthly now. The instinct to build doesn’t. We keep the team lean on purpose — a high bar, real support, real resources — because that’s where builders truly express themselves. The most common thing we hear from engineers after joining Flip is some version of “I could never have done this at my last company” . Deep industry expertise matched with ruthless execution creates wonderful work. That’s the whole formula. What you’ll build We’re serving an orchestrated system of agents answering millions of contacts daily and now also expanding into other modalities like chat. Pulling that off requires elite engineering paired with incredible DevOps — voice is unforgiving: it’s real-time, there are no retries or page refreshes, and the customer is literally on the line. The work breaks into three lanes: Vertical engineering — building the agents themselves: complex multi-step customer workflows and deep integrations into the contact center and the industries we serve — order systems, healthcare workflows, logistics. This is where “mostly works” isn’t shippable. Platform engineering — the orchestration layer every agent runs on: routing, state, tool use, and the primitives that let vertical teams ship fast without reinventing the engine. Inference & DevOps — we host our own models; low-latency serving at production scale is a core competency here, not a vendor line item. Plus the telephony, observability, and deployment infrastructure that keeps millions of live calls healthy. And the range here is real. Our engineers do everything from sitting face-to-face with customers to going deep on complex backend systems — you really get to pick where you fit. We don’t slot you into one of these on day one. There’s probably a place for you — we’ll find it together, and it’ll probably change as we grow. What we look for We intentionally wrote this as one role for senior and staff engineers, because we believe builders love to build — and how they build varies. Some want the flexibility of working alone and joining forces when it counts; some do their best work in a small pod. We don’t prescribe it. What we do hold as a core principle: we are always raising the bar on each other. As we grow, our best builders often end up with two or three engineers building behind them — if that’s a direction you want, it’s here. And if you’d rather stay a pure builder, that raises the bar too. Real production experience. You’ve built and owned systems where failure had consequences. We don’t count years — we look at what you’ve shipped and what you learned shipping it. Judgment that survives contact with production. Agentic development is how we work — but what we’re actually hiring is your experience: knowing what to ship, what to slow down on, and what never to ship at all. Low ego, high execution. You own outcomes, not tickets. You’d rather ship the thing than present the plan for the thing. Customer obsession. You want to be close to the problem — sometimes literally in the room — and you measure yourself by what the customer got. More About Us We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada. We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive and Simon Data. Our tech stack includes Python, MongoDB, AWS, Twilio, Datadog, Snowflake, and Omni. Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year. In the office 5 days/week, we collaborate in real time on the desk. Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for equity, in accordance with company policy, and subject to board approval. Compensation Range: $200,000 — $400,000 USD Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.
